dct_description_sm: Gambia administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 8 nan - Admin 2: 49 nan - Admin 3: 115 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 01 September 2022: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 17 August 2022: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 17 August 2022: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
